messages:
Evan (oncall): quick thread 6a8 working on a compact internal incident-comm wording lib specifically for paging -> handoff -> status-page flow. want to finalize placeholders and a few canned snippets.
Priya: yes please. make the required fields explicit otherwise handoffs lose context.
Lars: tiny ask: include an "IMPACT_METRIC" line so we can paste the exact query results (e.g., 8.2% errors / 14m). makes the decision to post external clearer.
Evan (oncall): good call. mandatory placeholders: {{INCIDENT_ID}}, {{OWNER}}, {{BACKUP}}, {{ETA_UTC}}, {{SERVICE_SCOPE}}, {{IMPACT_METRIC}}, {{CUSTOMER_IMPACT_SUMMARY}}, {{MITIGATION}}. optional: {{STATUS_PAGE_URL}}, {{EXTERNAL_POSTED}}.
Theo: add {{RETRY_HINT}} for customer actionable steps (e.g., retry with exponential backoff or use fallback model).
comms-bot: linked runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-comms-library|Incident Comms Library>
ops-scribe: pasting proposed skeleton (will PR to docs after sign-off):

```
INTERNAL INCIDENT MESSAGE - TEMPLATE
- TL;DR: one-line summary (what + customer impact)
- CUSTOMER IMPACT (one line): e.g., "~8% of requests for embeddings in us-west-2 returning 500"
- TIMELINE: bullets with timestamps
- SITUATION: what we see (no speculation)
- HYPOTHESIS (UNCONFIRMED) + VALIDATION PLAN
- MITIGATION (CURRENT): what's being done now
- NEXT STEPS & ETA: short list
- OWNER / BACKUP: who to page next
- IMPACT_METRIC: raw metric text to paste from dashboards
- CUSTOMER_SNIPPET (SUPPORT): short plain-text for support teams
- CUSTOMER_SNIPPET (PUBLIC): concise status page text
- HANDOFF CHECKLIST: see below
- LINKS: dashboards, traces, PRs, runbooks
```

Lina: add a short "EMPTHY_BLURB" line for internal drafts to remind authors to be human (internal only). e.g., "We understand the disruption this may cause and are prioritizing a fix."
Maya: request: include a "WHAT_USERS_CAN_DO" line when applicable, with explicit non-technical instructions.
Priya: and enforce the handoff checklist in the template. i've seen missing ETA/owner multiple times.
ops-scribe: handoff checklist draft:

```
HANDOFF CHECKLIST
- [ ] TL;DR present
- [ ] OWNER / BACKUP assigned
- [ ] HYPOTHESIS written and labeled UNCONFIRMED
- [ ] MITIGATION steps listed
- [ ] IMPACT_METRIC pasted
- [ ] CUSTOMER_SNIPPET(s) drafted
- [ ] STATUS PAGE decision noted (posted/holding)
- [ ] NEXT_UPDATE_ETA set
- [ ] Links to dashboards/traces attached
```

Lars: posting rules proposal: if IMPACT_METRIC >=5% errors for >=10m OR >100 distinct failed requests in 10m OR a named customer reports a failure -> post status page. open to adjusting thresholds.
Evan (oncall): we'll document exact queries in the runbook. Theo, think you can add a small cli to post status page from a template and flip {{EXTERNAL_POSTED}}?
Theo: yes. i'll add idempotency checks so we don't double-post. will PR after wording locked.
Maya: sample snippets (edit as needed):

```
PUBLIC - SEV1: We are investigating errors affecting the Redwood API ({{INCIDENT_ID}}) in {{REGION}}. Some requests may fail or see increased latency. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation and we will provide updates as available and aim for updates every 30 minutes while active. We apologize for the disruption.

SUPPORT - SEV2: Intermittent errors affecting embeddings in {{REGION}}. Some requests may succeed; try retrying with exponential backoff. Our team is investigating and will update in ~30 minutes.
```

Priya: tiny wording tweak: change "aim for updates every 30 minutes" to "we will provide updates as available and aim for updates every 30 minutes during active mitigation." avoids promising cadence when uncertain.
Evan (oncall): agreed, updating snippets accordingly.
Lina: also add a "NO_BLAME" reminder for writers: use factual language, avoid internal jargon when crafting public snippets (e.g., no "replica eviction").
ops-scribe: added a short "Writers' checklist" to help during pages:

```
WRITERS' CHECKLIST
- Use short sentences; active voice
- Keep customer-facing text non-technical
- Label hypotheses as "UNCONFIRMED"
- Include empathy sentence when customers impacted
- Don't promise exact ETAs unless verified
```

Theo: once docs land i can wire the status-post tool to templates and block posting unless the template contains required placeholders.
Lars: can we store canonical snippets in a central snippets file in docs and reference them from the template? reduces copy-editing.
Evan (oncall): yes. plan: add `docs/incident-messaging/snippets.md` indexed by severity and region. PR process: 1 review from comms + 1 from oncall.
comms-bot: created issue #1102 for "incident-comm templates + automation" by Evan (oncall) <https://redwood.internal/issues/1102|view issue>
ops-scribe: final example handoff message for practice (feel free to copy):

```
Evan (oncall): TL;DR: increased 500s on /v1/embeddings in us-west-2, partial customer impact.
CUSTOMER IMPACT: ~7.8% of embedding requests returning 500 in us-west-2; some customers report failures.
TIMELINE: 09:12 UTC first spike; 09:05 deploy completed earlier.
SITUATION: spike in errors correlated with recent deploy; traces enabled.
HYPOTHESIS (UNCONFIRMED): regression in batching logic; validation plan: rollback + compare traces.
MITIGATION (CURRENT): routed traffic to stable pool; initiating canary rollback.
NEXT STEPS: complete rollback (Theo) and validate traces (Lina). NEXT_UPDATE_ETA: 09:35 UTC.
OWNER / BACKUP: Theo (oncall) / Priya
IMPACT_METRIC: errors=7.8% over 15m (dashboard link)
STATUS PAGE: decision pending - posting criteria under review
CUSTOMER_SNIPPET: We are investigating intermittent errors affecting embeddings in us-west-2 ({{INCIDENT_ID}}). We are working to mitigate impact and will provide updates as available.
HANDOFF CHECKLIST: see template
LINKS: dashboards, traces, PRs
```

Maya: looks good. i'll add a short "what customers can try" line when appropriate.
Evan (oncall): thanks everyone. i'll open PR "incident-comm-kit: templates + snippets" and request reviews from comms & oncall. aiming to land today and then have Theo wire automation. will pin PR in #eng-oncall when live. :rocket:
